title: Revit Working Library - Families

entries.name: Lighting Fixture - Ceiling Linear
working_guidance: family names should identify category, mounting/condition and form without repeating type-level data
type names should encode selection-driving values such as size, output, performance and option code
avoid ambiguous labels such as Misc, Other or Test

entries.name: Structural Framing Family
working_guidance: align profile naming with type naming to avoid duplication
use consistent units across related types
keep narrative notes out of type names and place them in parameters

entries.name: Generic Annotation Family
working_guidance: annotation families should reference governed text and line styles
reuse approved families rather than creating near-duplicates
persistent family content should carry stable identity and change-control trace

working_rules: Prefer reusable loadable family content over one-off modeled substitutes when the content is expected to recur.
Do not infer approval from the presence of a family example in this library.
Family and type naming should remain human-readable and machine-parseable.
Do not embed organization, client or project names in reusable family identities.
Parameter and material dependencies should be explicit where they affect scheduling, tagging, graphics or exchange.

provenance.migration_note: Family and type examples retained as non-authoritative working data. Organization, client and project identifiers removed.
